notes: E10 showed the positive branch is not a single quadratic: the small-x points (12–30) sit above the old fit while the large-x points (50–85) sit below it. I split the positive branch into two quadratics (small-x and large-x) with a linear blend between x=30 and x=50, keeping the sharp floor transitions at x≈3.8 and x≈-20.
